name: How does AEO differ from traditional SEO content?

mainEntity.name: How does AEO differ from traditional SEO content?

acceptedAnswer.text: While both AEO and traditional SEO aim for search visibility, their primary focus differs. Traditional SEO often targets keywords to rank entire pages, emphasizing factors like backlinks and overall domain authority. AEO, however, is more granular, focusing on identifying specific questions users ask and crafting precise, often shorter, answers within content. AEO content is structured to be easily extractable by search engines to serve as direct answers, often appearing above organic search results. This distinction means AEO content is optimized for clarity and conciseness, directly addressing user intent.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO focuses on direct, concise answers for specific user questions, often for featured snippets, while traditional SEO aims to rank entire pages for keywords.
